senses.gloss:
एण एण, अस्, ई, m. f. or एणक, अस्, m. a kind
of deer or antelope, described as being of a black
colour with beautiful eyes and short legs; (in astron.)
Capricorn.
—एण-तिलक, अस्, m. the moon; (the
marks of an antelope being fancifully visible on its
disk.)
—एण-दृश्, क्, m. Capricorn.
—एण-भृत्, त्,
m. the moon.
—एणाजिन (एण-अज्˚), अम्, n. deer-
skin.
—एणी-पचन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race (cooking
antelopes for food).
—एणी-पद, अस्, m. a kind of
snake; (ई), f. a kind of poisonous insect.

एणाङ्क (एण-अङ्˚), अस्, m. ‘deer-marked,’ the
moon.
—एणाङ्क-मणि, इस्, m. the moon-gem [cf.
चन्द्र-कान्त].
